sources.name: PanTHERIA
sources.decision: Do not bulk-admit physiological or life-history aggregates.
sources.reason: Metadata describes general linear models correcting species values for sex, age and other delimiters; raw source lists are species-level. Non-EXT column names do not guarantee observed measurements. Current release imports mapped ranges only.
sources.requirement: Trace unmodeled original species observations, definitions and cohorts before playable admission.

sources.name: Lislevand, Figuerola and Szekely 2007 avian body sizes
sources.decision: Raw subset saved for review; not approved for new play.
sources.reason: Methods permit range midpoints in some contributing studies; reported sex-specific sample counts alone cannot establish which rows are measured means. Qualitative behavioral scores require checking the original coding and semantics.

sources.name: Myhrvold et al. 2015 amniote life histories
sources.decision: Use original sparse records, never indiscriminate consolidated medians.
sources.reason: Consolidated output shares species and subspecies values and interpolates medians; sparse records can still encode different summaries from one underlying source. Sex-ratio comparisons need matched source/cohort definitions.
